'''December 1999 New Brunswick tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in New Brunswick, New Jersey on 4 December 1999. [[Ray Bordier]] won it. It is known from Scott Lingrell's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d133">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-12-04-new-brunswick-new-jersey-12-4-99d133/ new-brunswick-new-jersey-12-4-99], DeckTech (Scott "CRingwell" Lingrell, 4 December 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-12-04-new-brunswick-new-jersey-12-4-99d133/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 4 December 1999
* '''Site:''' New Brunswick, New Jersey
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 24
* '''Winner:''' [[Ray Bordier]]
